FilterFunnelExplore.description: Optional exploration: sweep effect_size_coverage over a range and write filter_funnel-{chromosome}.csv.

effect_size_coverage.description: Range/step for effect_size_coverage (values in [0,1], e.g. min=0.80, max=0.99, step=0.05)

FilterFunnelExplore.title: FilterFunnelExplore

FilterFunnelRangeSpec.description: Range and step for sweeping one biological filter (min, min+step, ... up to max).
FilterFunnelRangeSpec.title: FilterFunnelRangeSpec

alpha.description: Significance level for statistical tests (q-value threshold)
alpha.title: Alpha

biological_only_effect_size_coverage.description: Optional rescue track for biologically strong but underpowered loci (q > alpha). When set, apply the same per-context effect-mass selection to non-significant positions and flag them as biological-only.
biological_only_effect_size_coverage.title: Biological Only Effect Size Coverage

biological_only_max_candidates.description: Maximum number of non-significant candidates per context to consider for biological-only rescue before ECDF rescoring.
biological_only_max_candidates.title: Biological Only Max Candidates

centroid1_path.description: [Deprecated] Path to single centroid .h5 file (for single-context mode)
centroid1_path.title: Centroid1 Path

centroid1_validation_samples.description: Validation cohort paths for centroid1, or the string 'use_metadata' to read from centroid H5 (default when omitted: use_metadata).
centroid1_validation_samples.title: Centroid1 Validation Samples

centroid2_path.description: [Deprecated] Path to single centroid .h5 file (for single-context mode)
centroid2_path.title: Centroid2 Path

centroid2_validation_samples.description: Validation cohort paths for centroid2, or 'use_metadata'.
centroid2_validation_samples.title: Centroid2 Validation Samples

centroid_self_check_top_k.description: If set, centroid self-check uses only the top K DMPs by effect_size (most biologically important). Reduces noise from low-effect loci that can make both centroids classify as class0. E.g. 5000.
centroid_self_check_top_k.title: Centroid Self Check Top K

chromosome.description: Chromosome(s) to process. Can be a single chromosome (e.g., '1', 'X', '22') or a list (e.g., ['1', '2', 'X'])
chromosome.title: Chromosome

classifier_dmp_selection.description: How to build the prediction DMP panel: elbow = effect_size distribution trim only; featurecuts_validation = choose top-k by balanced accuracy on configured validation samples (requires real validation data).
classifier_dmp_selection.title: Classifier Dmp Selection

classifier_export_margin_abs.description: Dual export: add this many top-ranked DMPs beyond k_core for the extended classifier CSV.
classifier_export_margin_abs.title: Classifier Export Margin Abs

classifier_export_margin_pct.description: Dual export: extend dmps-{chrom}-classifier-extended.csv to at least ceil(k_core * (1 + margin_pct)) for mapper/gene annotation.
classifier_export_margin_pct.title: Classifier Export Margin Pct

classifier_export_max_dmps.description: Dual export: cap k_extended per chromosome (annotation panel only; core pickle unchanged).
classifier_export_max_dmps.title: Classifier Export Max Dmps

context_weight_direction.description: How to derive context weight from trimmed mean effect_size: 'inverse' = weight ∝ 1/mean_effect_size (down-weight contexts with inflated effect_size, e.g. CHH); 'proportional' = weight ∝ mean_effect_size (legacy).
context_weight_direction.title: Context Weight Direction

contexts.description: List of methylation contexts to process (e.g., ['CG'], ['CG', 'CHG'], or ['CG', 'CHG', 'CHH']). Default is ['CG'] as it typically provides the strongest signal for most analyses.
contexts.title: Contexts

debug.description: Enable debug output (e.g. classifier predict_proba in centroid self-check, extra validation logs).
debug.title: Debug

delta_mean_reduction.description: Coarse pre-statistical gate: before running the statistical test, discard positions where |delta_mean| < delta_mean_reduction. Reduces the test set for expensive contexts (CHH). If null, no coarse gate is applied.
delta_mean_reduction.title: Delta Mean Reduction

detection_mode.description: legacy: run discovery plus inline classifier panel selection and optional pickle export. discovery_only: export dmps-{chr}-discovery.csv only; run methyl-dmp-select and pipeline.classifier separately.
detection_mode.title: Detection Mode

discovery_dynamic_dmp_cutoff_enabled.description: If True, apply the same effect_size elbow trim to the discovery export in dual mode. Default False: discovery keeps all biologically filtered DMPs sorted by importance.
discovery_dynamic_dmp_cutoff_enabled.title: Discovery Dynamic Dmp Cutoff Enabled

dmp_export_mode.description: unified: single dmps-{chrom}.csv (classifier subset; may expand rows to min_dmps_for_export for mapper). dual: dmps-{chrom}-discovery.csv (broad, mapper/enricher) + dmps-{chrom}-classifier.csv (prediction panel) + metadata JSON.
dmp_export_mode.title: Dmp Export Mode

dynamic_dmp_cutoff_enabled.description: If True, dynamically analyze the effect_size distribution (elbow detection) to identify and drop the long tail of low-importance DMPs. Maximizes retained DMPs while removing weak signal.
dynamic_dmp_cutoff_enabled.title: Dynamic Dmp Cutoff Enabled

dynamic_dmp_cutoff_relaxation.description: Multiplier for the dynamically calculated elbow threshold. 1.0 = exact elbow. <1.0 = relaxed (keeps more DMPs), >1.0 = stricter.
dynamic_dmp_cutoff_relaxation.title: Dynamic Dmp Cutoff Relaxation

ecdf_grid_size.description: Number of grid points for ECDF/KS and overlap integration (single grid; default 256).
ecdf_grid_size.title: Ecdf Grid Size

effect_size_coverage.description: Biological filter: select the minimum set of statistical DMPs (per context) whose effect sizes sum to this fraction of total effect mass. 1.0 = keep all statistical DMPs (no biological filter); 0.95 = keep the minimum set covering 95%% of total effect mass. Applied per-context so CG/CHG/CHH are selected independently.
effect_size_coverage.title: Effect Size Coverage

effect_size_mean_level_k.description: For saturating: k in μ/(μ+k). For boundary: τ (tau), e.g. 0.1; effect_size × min(1, max(μ1,μ2)/τ) so signals below τ are down-weighted.
effect_size_mean_level_k.title: Effect Size Mean Level K

effect_size_mean_level_k_by_context.description: Optional per-context k for mean-level weight (e.g. {"CHH": 0.20, "CHG": 0.10}). Use a larger k for CHH so effect_size is naturally lower there; CG uses effect_size_mean_level_k. None = same k for all contexts.
effect_size_mean_level_k_by_context.title: Effect Size Mean Level K By Context

effect_size_mean_level_use_max.description: If True, use max(mean1,mean2) for the mean-level factor; if False, use (mean1+mean2)/2. Formula uses max.
effect_size_mean_level_use_max.title: Effect Size Mean Level Use Max

effect_size_mean_level_weight.description: Mean-level weight: 'sqrt', 'linear', 'saturating' (μ/(μ+k)), or 'boundary' (min(1, μ/τ)); use max(μ1,μ2) so one group ≥ τ removes penalty.
effect_size_mean_level_weight.title: Effect Size Mean Level Weight

effect_size_use_mean_level.description: Multiply effect_size by max(μ₁,μ₂)/(max(μ₁,μ₂)+k) to reduce inflated scores at low methylation (e.g. CHH).
effect_size_use_mean_level.title: Effect Size Use Mean Level

effect_size_weight_power.description: Power applied to normalized effect_size when building classifier weights: weight_i = (effect_size_i / max)^power. Default 1.0 (no change). Use > 1 (e.g. 2.0–3.0) for large DMP sets so weak positions contribute less; higher values concentrate weight more on top positions and can improve centroid separation and class probability margins.
effect_size_weight_power.title: Effect Size Weight Power

enable_platt_calibration.description: Enable Platt scaling calibration on validation data during classification
enable_platt_calibration.title: Enable Platt Calibration

export_classifier.description: When True in legacy mode, write classifier pickle after panel selection. Set False when pipeline.classifier trains the model.
export_classifier.title: Export Classifier

export_sample_size_estimate.description: If True, add n_estimated_per_group column to DMP CSV: sample size per group needed for target_power (two-sample t-test, Cohen's d from delta_mean and combined variance).
export_sample_size_estimate.title: Export Sample Size Estimate

fail_if_below_target.description: Strict FeatureCuts: fail when target BA is unmet or selected k is below min_core_dmps instead of expanding the panel into worse held-out performance.
fail_if_below_target.title: Fail If Below Target

featurecuts_exhaustive_search.description: When classifier_dmp_selection=featurecuts_validation: search more k candidates (slower, more thorough).
featurecuts_exhaustive_search.title: Featurecuts Exhaustive Search

featurecuts_max_candidates.description: Cap on candidate k values evaluated in featurecuts mode (None = auto).
featurecuts_max_candidates.title: Featurecuts Max Candidates

featurecuts_max_k_cap.description: Optional upper bound on k when running featurecuts (speed). None = use all rows after elbow prefilter.
featurecuts_max_k_cap.title: Featurecuts Max K Cap

filter_funnel_explore.description: Optional. Sweep effect_size_coverage over a range and write filter_funnel-{chromosome}.csv per chromosome, then aggregate to filter_funnel.csv with a leading chromosome column. Set to null to disable.

fixed_dmp_panel.description: Path to a fixed DMP panel CSV (chromosome,position,context,...). If provided, bypasses statistical/biological discovery and uses only these positions (for production freeze).
fixed_dmp_panel.title: Fixed Dmp Panel

lambda_var.description: Variance penalty strength in effect_size = |delta_mean| * (1 - overlap) * exp(-lambda_var * (sqrt(variance1) + sqrt(variance2))).
lambda_var.title: Lambda Var

max_tau2_for_dmp.description: Optional heterogeneity filter. If set, drop positions where both groups exceed this between-sample variance estimate (tau2), because they are likely heterogeneous subpopulations rather than clean DMPs.
max_tau2_for_dmp.title: Max Tau2 For Dmp

min_core_dmps.description: Optional small guardrail on the core classifier panel (k_core) after FeatureCuts. Use only to avoid trivially tiny panels; does not apply a large fixed export floor.
min_core_dmps.title: Min Core Dmps

min_coverage.description: Minimum total coverage (Sm+uC) per position in each centroid for a position to be a DMP candidate. Same default as MethylCentroid; use higher for stricter precision when comparing centroids.
min_coverage.title: Min Coverage

min_dmps_for_export.description: Unified mode: if the classifier/elbow subset is smaller than this but more biological DMPs exist, the exported dmps-{chrom}.csv is widened to this many top-importance rows while the saved classifier still uses the elbow subset. Dual mode: warn when the discovery table has fewer than this many rows.
min_dmps_for_export.title: Min Dmps For Export

min_samples_abs.description: Absolute minimum number of samples (N) per position in each centroid.
min_samples_abs.title: Min Samples Abs

min_samples_pct.description: Minimum fraction of that centroid's cohort (samples) per position. Effective min N per centroid = max(min_samples_abs, ceil(min_samples_pct * cohort_size)). Cohort size is resolved from validation sample lists when set, else centroid metadata (n_samples or sample_paths/samples_used length), else max(N) across positions as a fallback.
min_samples_pct.title: Min Samples Pct

min_selected_dmps.description: Deprecated alias for min_core_dmps when min_core_dmps is unset. Does not widen mapper exports; use classifier_export_margin_* for annotation panels.
min_selected_dmps.title: Min Selected Dmps

significance_test.description: Statistical test for DMP significance: 'ks_ecdf' (Kolmogorov-Smirnov on precise ECDF; recommended and default) or 'mann_whitney' (Mann-Whitney from bin counts; alternative).
significance_test.title: Significance Test

target_balanced_accuracy.description: Optional target BA for FeatureCuts. When set with classifier_dmp_selection=featurecuts_validation, the selector chooses the minimum top-k (by effect_size rank) that reaches this BA.
target_balanced_accuracy.title: Target Balanced Accuracy

target_power.description: Target power (1 - type II error) for sample size estimation when export_sample_size_estimate is True (e.g. 0.8 = 80%% power).
target_power.title: Target Power

temperature.description: Temperature for softmax in trained classifier (1.0 = original, higher softens probabilities)
temperature.title: Temperature

trimmed_percentile_high.description: Upper percentile for trimmed mean - removes top X% (default: 0.01 = remove top 1%). High effect_size DMPs are critical for classification, so only extreme outliers are removed.
trimmed_percentile_high.title: Trimmed Percentile High

trimmed_percentile_low.description: Lower percentile for trimmed mean - removes bottom X% (default: 0.10 = remove bottom 10%). Low effect_size DMPs are less informative.
trimmed_percentile_low.title: Trimmed Percentile Low

use_context_weights.description: Enable trimmed-mean context weighting for multi-context analysis
use_context_weights.title: Use Context Weights

validation_min_coverage.description: Min coverage when extracting methylation from validation/centroid samples. Use a value lower than the centroid's min_coverage (e.g. 4 if centroid used 10) so validation samples contribute values at more positions and better match lower-coverage patient data.
validation_min_coverage.title: Validation Min Coverage

validation_n_repeats.description: Number of repeated stratified holdout splits when validation_split_ratio > 0.
validation_n_repeats.title: Validation N Repeats

validation_samples_base_path.description: When centroid H5 stores sample directory basenames without samples_base_path, prepend this directory (typically project samples_base_path).
validation_samples_base_path.title: Validation Samples Base Path

validation_split_ratio.description: Fraction of validation samples per class held out as a test row split for BA (repeated stratified). 0 = no row holdout (calibration and evaluation indices are the same — optimistic). Use e.g. 0.2 for generalization-style BA within the validation matrix.
validation_split_ratio.title: Validation Split Ratio
